input.instruction: Complete a future cancellation-request document. Ready means identified policy, verified authority, future date, and consent are supplied; no execution occurs in this dataset. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: My lease ends November 30, 2026. Cancel policy P-EX040 on that date. I also have open claim CL-EX040 and do not want it erased.
Do you mean immediate cancellation today or a future cancellation on November 30?
Future cancellation on November 30, 2026. Keep my insurance active until then and keep the theft claim open for review.
Do you authorize that exact policy and date, and are you requesting any separate autopay change?
I authorize cancellation of P-EX040 on November 30. Do not make a separate autopay change now.
Is there an approved refund amount or payment schedule in the billing information?
None that I have been given. Please do not estimate a refund. Just prepare the future cancellation and preserve my existing claim.

cancellation_effective_date.description: Exact future cancellation date confirmed by the customer.

cancellation_consented.description: Whether the customer explicitly consents to cancel the identified policy on the stated date.

policy_status_today.description: Current issued policy status; a future request is not cancellation today.

claim_to_preserve.description: Existing claim explicitly requested to remain unaffected.

separate_autopay_change_requested.description: True for a separate present autopay instruction; false when expressly declined.

approved_refund_amount.description: Approved refund amount only if supplied by billing authority, otherwise null.
